status: Source-grounded restic ownership/interface and compatibility targets; not a production SDK, wire format, or fresh native conformance.

contracts.status: Source/caller/codec review; no namespace substitution or malformed-repository runtime defect reproduced.
contracts.target: Preserve existing scoped loaders, typed blob handles and wire IDs. Prefer narrow role admission and caller tests; a global ID-type rewrite is not selected.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Internal snapshot/blob/prune callers, CLI selectors and JSON codecs. Preserve full-ID strings, optional fields, unknown tree keys and legacy null node lists.
contracts.keepCurrent: Reasonable when callers retain file/blob roles and validate required roots. Names and tests may supply protection without pervasive conversions.
remaining: Qualify actual risky conversions, missing required snapshot roots and legacy/invalid codecs.
Internal wrappers require explicit codec delegation and caller review; they do not prove authorization or complete root discovery.
Preserve LoadRaw data-plus-error semantics; available bytes are not automatically verified content.

contracts.status: False empty success/mixed JSON is prior native evidence. Early-return finalization risk is source-supported, not fresh native execution.
contracts.target: Keep unreadable scope separate from intentional skip, retain matches, finalize the array when output permits, route diagnostics to stderr, and report incomplete traversal as failure.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Pattern-search caller and automation consuming existing JSON arrays/status. Do not change the global ordinary-output printer or replace the array schema silently.
contracts.keepCurrent: Current successful selection and array output remain. The reproduced false completion is not an acceptable alternative for a truthful query contract.
remaining: Root/nested faults after earlier results, multiple snapshots, policy skips, cancellation, ID-search completion and output-write failure.
The old model postcondition does not prove a streaming finalizer; adapter/candidate implementation remains open.
Retain errors from all result writes; a successful final write alone does not verify the earlier stream.

owners: statistics mode reducers and typed blob weights
contracts.status: Native type-boundary and mode differences retained; complete-closure and location-reference alternatives are proposals.
contracts.target: Name event traversal versus full closure and mode-specific accumulation. Preserve unavailable measurements and distinguish metadata counts from payload availability or physical reclaimability.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Diff/statistics JSON consumers and human summaries; existing field meanings and rename/reference policies need a deliberate compatibility decision.
contracts.keepCurrent: Keep existing values while the intended counting policy is unresolved; clarify the measure rather than adopt another reducer automatically.
remaining: Full closure versus event interpretation, shared content across type boundaries, location/rename semantics, unavailable weights and traversal faults.

owners: backup command summary and source-error handling
contracts.status: Existing metadata reuse, partial saved snapshot and simulated-token evidence; no fresh capture operation here.
contracts.target: Compose requested input/capture policy, completeness, simulated or saved reference, and fatal outcome from existing facts. Preserve explicit performance policy.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Backup CLI and wrappers reading dry_run, summary, source errors and status. No generic saved claim from snapshot_id alone or silent change to metadata reuse.
contracts.keepCurrent: Existing fields/status suffice when interpreted together; preserve partial useful snapshots and explicit reread controls.
remaining: Live source races, failed/unknown backend publication, interrupted workers, input codecs, remote consistency and all hosts.

contracts.status: Prior native reference/prune joins and finite proposals; complete backend acknowledgement remains unqualified.
contracts.target: Keep requested/selected IDs, confirmed/failed/unknown removals and later prune result separate. Hold reclamation on incomplete roots; lineage/provenance edges are not live content edges.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Explicit-ID and grouped forget, combined prune, human/JSON result consumers. Add receipts opt-in/versioned; no repository schema change selected.
contracts.keepCurrent: Existing diagnostics plus independent reference queries remain usable, with concurrent-state limits. No failure implies rollback or reclaimed space.
remaining: Unknown/partial acknowledgements, changed selections, exact roots, remote listing consistency, concurrent owners and destructive maintenance faults.

contracts.status: Unix signal-error concern and tri-state alternative are source/proposal-only; existing live/retired/wait evidence is preserved.
contracts.target: Use nonintrusive reachable/absent/denied/unknown observations, preserving nonexpired records on uncertainty and keeping age policy independent.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Unix and Windows probe implementations, stale classifier and cleanup reports. New fields cannot make older clients honor a new lifetime rule.
contracts.keepCurrent: Existing same-user deployment assumptions and age policy are a bounded alternative; arbitrary creator identity is not established.
remaining: Safe permission and PID-reuse controls, reboot/clock/host identity, refresh/standby failures, unreadable records and mixed clients.
No unrelated process signal, force-all cleanup, or recovery deletion is authorized by this proposal.

owners: index repair and selected data checks
contracts.status: Prior native verification/deletion controls, source-selected verification set and leaf-aware model alternative; no new restore or repair.
contracts.target: Report the actual verification/read set and preserve explicit destructive authority. Index reconstruction is not content recovery; child-preserving deletion is a separate policy choice.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Restore flags/help/results, integrity checks and repair callers. Preserve current parent-selected subtree semantics unless a deliberate compatibility change is chosen.
contracts.keepCurrent: Existing overwrite, verification and subtree-selection rules are legitimate when described accurately; no automatic stronger verification or deletion policy.
remaining: Candidate recursive implementation, physical target admission, links/reparse points, races, failed writes/deletion, missing data, all hosts and broader restoration.

contracts.status: Prior native wrapper results and help/output mismatch; stronger revocation and fault outcomes untested.
contracts.target: Report exact saved/replaced wrapper IDs and confirmed or uncertain effects using current owners. Preserve duplicate-password wrappers and process-local current-key meaning.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Command-specific text/JSON consumers; new structured command results require explicit compatibility. No encryption/master-key or repository format change.
contracts.keepCurrent: The current key model and key-list inspection remain sound; help should not promise an ID and return only a description.
remaining: Failure after wrapper creation, verification/removal errors, unknown acknowledgements and concurrent writers.
No private key material, copied-master revocation guarantee or cryptographic qualification in this synthesis.

contracts.status: Prior native mixed request outcomes; strict unknown-name completion remains model-only.
contracts.target: Retain per-name requested/applied/skipped/unknown/failed results and independent confirmed or uncertain effects. Avoid a generic force-retry suggestion for already-current format.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Migration human/JSON callers and automation. Opt-in structured result or stricter completion needs compatibility review; preserve encrypted formats and current upgrade recovery.
contracts.keepCurrent: Current statuses plus diagnostics and repository-version readback are usable but do not provide general per-name acknowledgement.
remaining: Unknown/known request mixtures, forced paths, failed save/reupload, process loss, compatibility with older clients and backend durability.

contracts.status: Existing native metadata-sensitive copy evidence; no new identity or copy policy selected.
contracts.target: Name the actual metadata comparison projection and preserve origin as operation provenance rather than retaining/authentication authority.
contracts.callersAndFormats: Copy skip decision, snapshots and source/destination publication reports; existing repositories and metadata formats preserved.
contracts.keepCurrent: Reasonable when the existing compared fields are intentional; comment/tests may suffice without another schema.
remaining: Omitted-field meaning, duplicate tags/paths, partial/unknown destination publication and remote backends.

limits: Prior reports/models retain original premises and qualified profiles.
Current upstream status, crypto correctness and source-to-binary reproduction remain unreviewed.
Full application and nine-program goal are incomplete; production implementation requires a separately selected decision.
